name: Defined ascorbate-reduced, bicarbonate-buffered mineral medium (anaerobic/aerobic, with growth substrates) (PMC9765128)
description: defined ascorbate-reduced, bicarbonate-buffered mineral medium (anaerobic/aerobic, with growth substrates) — a defined medium extracted from Becker et al. (2022). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Becker et al. Systems Biology of Aromatic Compound Catabolism in Facultative Anaerobic Aromatoleum aromaticum EbN1T. mSystems (2022). DOI: 10.1128/msystems.00685-22. [PMC9765128]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: cultivated under nitrate-reducing conditions in a defined ascorbate-reduced and bicarbonate-buffered mineral medium... The following five growth substrates...were used (...): acetate (8 mM), benzoate ). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: medium.
provenance.verification_evidence: A. aromaticum EbN1T was cultivated under nitrate-reducing conditions in a defined ascorbate-reduced and bicarbonate-buffered mineral medium, as well as under oxic conditions in essentially the same mineral medium (devoid of ascorbate and nitrate) at 28°C, as previously described (59). The following five growth substrates ... acetate (8 mM), benzoate (4 mM anaerobic, 2 mM aerobic), 3-hydroxybenzoat
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.notes contains 'Extracted from the primary paper'
